transcript.text: Good morning, Dr. Morgan. I'm Ms. Romero, the Instructional Technology Coordinator, and I've completed my technology review for this project. My key finding is that personal phones cannot be used for school recordings. The project must use district tablets, store the source files in the restricted OralHistory drive, and delete recordings exactly 45 days after the final class presentation. I want to note that storing source files in that restricted drive does not prohibit publishing consented recordings on the public school website. Additionally, the technology plan must include a secure-storage configuration record.
